name: Lantern
summary: Highlights the section a reader came to from a search result.
readme:
Lantern reads the words a reader searched for and marks the first section that contains them.

## Use

Add the plugin and build the site again. Nothing else changes.

- Works without JavaScript turned on: the page stays as it is.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

name: Ledger
summary: Keeps a changelog page from the release notes in your repository.
readme:
Ledger turns `CHANGELOG.md` sections into one page per release.

## Use

Keep your changelog in the [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) shape. Ledger does the rest.

name: Compass
summary: Adds a page map to long guides.
readme:
Compass lists the headings of a long guide in a side column.

> Compass is a sample record: the theme ships no such plugin.

name: Stamp
summary: Prints the last-updated date from the commit history.
readme: Stamp reads the last commit that touched each page and prints its date under the title.

name: Relay
summary: Sends new posts to a feed reader service.
readme: Relay pings your feed reader service after each build so new posts show up sooner.
